'''Benley Coplin''' was a [[Two Rivers]] resident.

== Activities ==
While battling the [[Seanchan]] during [[The Path of Daggers]], [[Rand al'Thor]] questions whether he can trust anyone, and compares himself to Benly, a paranoid [[Coplin]] from the [[Two Rivers]].

Benly starves to death as his paranoia leads him to believe that someone will poison his food.
